facts.business: Skyline Millars Limited is engaged in real estate development, recognizing revenue from ongoing real-estate contracts over time using the percentage of completion method under Ind AS 115.
key_risks: Uncertain tax positions subject to periodic challenges by local tax authorities on a range of tax matters including indirect tax, involving significant management judgment to determine possible outcomes.

Revenue recognition from ongoing real-estate contracts using percentage of completion method requires significant judgements including estimate of balance costs to complete, identification of contractual obligations, Company's rights to receive payments for performance completed till date, and changes in scope and consequential revised contract price.
